title: Topic 18: Clothes & Colours - Vocabulary
description: Core words for clothes & colours: clothes, shirt, dress, shoes, jacket, wear, red, blue, black, white (green and yellow appear in texts as passive exposure - tested colours are the big four). 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Name clothes and colours; describe what people are wearing
introductionText:
clothes = shirts, dresses, jackets - all of it!
shirt = on your top  |  dress = one piece, top to legs
shoes = on your feet (always TWO - shoes ARE!)
jacket = warm, for cold days  |  wear = have clothes on
colours: red | blue | black | white
+ phrase bank: What are you wearing? | What colour
is it? | these shoes
+ grammar note: colour BEFORE the thing: a red dress,
white shoes (like big table - T4!)

vocabularyBlocks.title: Clothes & Colours words
words: white (green and yellow appear in texts as passive exposure - tested colours are the big four)
exampleSentences: He is wearing a blue shirt.
I wear a jacket in winter.

grammarBlocks.title: PRESENT CONTINUOUS with WEAR (G10: She is wearing a red dres
grammarBlocks.explanation: PRESENT CONTINUOUS with WEAR (G10: She is wearing a red dress) + habit contrast (I wear a jacket every winter) + THESE/THOSE recycled with plural clothes (G4: these shoes, those jackets)
patterns: colour before noun: a RED dress, BLACK shoes
the G10 contrast on its most useful verb

explanations.A1-T18-VOC-Q1: Shoes = feet, always a pair - these shoes ARE.
explanations.A1-T18-VOC-Q3: Jacket = the warm one, for winter (T17).
explanations.A1-T18-VOC-Q5: Snow (T17) is weather - very cold on your head, and NOT clothes!
explanations.A1-T18-VOC-Q6: What COLOUR...? -> answer with a colour!
explanations.A1-T18-VOC-Q7: Right now -> IS WEARING (G10, same as T17!).
explanations.A1-T18-VOC-Q8: Every day = habit -> wear. Today, on me now -> am wearing.
